key_information_units.information: Headline financial performance: Net revenue increased by 11.3% to SEK 3,962.6M (2025 vs 2024), with EBIT declining to SEK 78.2M (2.0% margin) due to warehouse automation costs, resulting in a net loss of SEK 3.0M versus profit of SEK 21.0M in 2024.

Nordics segment (Sweden, Norway, Finland, Denmark) accounted for 93.4% of sales (SEK 3,699.8M) with 12.0% growth, while Europe segment (Germany, Austria, Poland, Netherlands) declined 1.3% to SEK 130.7M following operational reorganization.
key_information_units.source_evidence: MANAGEMENT REPORT page 63 (Net sales and results per segment)

key_information_units.information: Commissioning of a new SEK 500M automated warehouse in Vansbro, increasing total order capacity to approximately 100,000 orders per day, with full operation expected in early 2026.
Retail expansion included the launch of Lyko's first Fab Store (500 sqm) in Täby Centrum, opening of a third store in Finland and a fifth store in Norway, bringing total stores to 34.
key_information_units.source_evidence: SELECTED EVENTS page 47 (Fab Store facts) and MANAGEMENT REPORT page 62 (Significant events); city names and exact dates in source_evidence

key_information_units.information: Strategic development of own brands included the relaunch of Make Up Store and launch of Scandinavian Soap Factory, strengthening margins and assortment uniqueness.
key_information_units.source_evidence: OWN BRANDS page 19 and CEO'S STATEMENT page 7

key_information_units.information: Liquidity position strengthened with net debt (excl. IFRS 16) at SEK 292.5M versus SEK 333.1M, cash and cash equivalents at SEK 452.5M, supported by ongoing banking agreements.
Brand awareness improved significantly, with spontaneous awareness reaching 51% in Sweden, 46% in Norway, and 30% in Finland.
key_information_units.source_evidence: STRATEGY page 16 (Brand awareness chart); demographic scope (women 16-60) in source_evidence

key_information_units.information: Strategic focus areas include growth in existing markets, broadening assortment, geographic expansion via 'online first' model, store network development, own brand growth, brand awareness enhancement, platform development, and strategic acquisitions.

Material post-reporting events include a cost savings program targeting SEK 100M annual savings, lease of a new store in Charlottenberg, launch of Gleeze own brand, and extension of RCFs with banks until 2028.
key_information_units.source_evidence: EVENTS AFTER THE END OF THE YEAR page 65; specific dates (Q1 2026, April 1 2026) in source_evidence
